items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Wilson and his orchestra, Gordon Griffin, trumpet, Rudy Powell, yourself, Teddy, John True hart again, Grachan Moncure the second on bass, and Cozy and Billie Holiday.
